title: Junior Project Engineer
abstract: A fantastic entry level engineering position, open to recent graduate or junior engineer!
location: Murwillumbah, Lismore & Far North Coast NSW
bullets: Kick starts your engineering career with Stone & Wood Brewery!
Be part of Australia's leading beverage company - Lion
Permanent Full Time position, monthly product allowance!
content_text:
Due to an exciting internal promotion, we're looking for a Graduate / Junior Project Engineer to join our Engineering team at Stone & Wood Brewery in Murwillumbah!
Reporting to our Engineering Leader, this is a fantastic opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career engineer to gain hands-on experience delivering engineering projects in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
You'll work alongside experienced engineers, get involved in a variety of projects and see your ideas come to life on the brewery floor! 
Start Date: We're ideally looking for someone who can start ASAP, but we're flexible for a mid-January 2027 start for the right candidate.
What you'll be doing
- Supporting engineering and capital projects from planning through to installation and commissioning.
- Working closely with our Brewing, Packaging, Quality and Engineering teams to deliver practical solutions.
- Assisting with project planning, budgeting and coordinating contractors and suppliers.
- Identifying opportunities to improve equipment reliability, plant performance and efficiency.
- Getting hands-on exposure to brewery equipment, production processes and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Learning from experienced engineers and collaborating with our wider Group Engineering team.
What we're looking for
You don't need years of experience! We're more interested in finding someone who's curious, proactive and eager to learn.
Ideally, you'll bring:
- A completed or near-completed degree in Mechanical, Chemical or Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
- A genuine interest in manufacturing, engineering projects and problem-solving.
- A practical, hands-on approach and willingness to get involved on site.
- Good communication, teamwork and organisational skills.
- A proactive attitude and commitment to safety and continuous improvement.
Previous experience through internships, university projects or manufacturing placements would be great, but isn't essential.
Application closes on Monday 23rd of November. 
We’re a certified B Corp, which means we care about people, planet and purpose—not just profit.
